title: Application of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company, under the provisons of G.L. c 164, § 94G as amended by St. 1981, c. 375 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 199 for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quartely fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billiig months of August, September and October, 1986. The fuel charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable cost of fuels and power purchased by the Company. Application is also made by Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of he Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
